summary: Headless mode lets growmos run its whole loop without an agent at the keyboard: growmos ingest calls an LLM API directly for extraction, resolution, profiles, gold and review, and growmos query --auto answers questions. It is stdlib-only and provider-neutral (Anthropic, OpenAI-compatible, xAI, any base URL) and follows the playbook's model split — a fast model for extraction and a reasoning model for judgment. The extraction cap bounds unattended cost.
